2105-4598-6791-8330.easyPrerequisites: Combat Celebrant hasn't been exerted this turn.
2105-4598-6791-8330.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2105-4598-6791-8330.description:
Cast Massimo by paying its mana cost plus commander tax if applicable.
When Massimo enters, it triggers, exiling Essence Flux from your graveyard and giving Massimo the listed ability.
Declare Massimo and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage with Massimo. Its ability triggers, casting a copy of Essence Flux from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Essence Flux, blinking Combat Celebrant.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

3661-5006-6797-8170.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell using Lurrus this turn if Shield Sphere is starting in your graveyard.
3661-5006-6797-8170.description:
Cast Shield Sphere by paying {0}.
Flickering Hound triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Resolve the Shield Sphere spell. Then, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Shield Sphere, putting a +1/+1 counter on Phantom Train and causing it to become a creature until end of turn
Repeat.

3755-4068-4770-6090.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Mountain.
3755-4068-4770-6090.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it and Arahbo trigger.
Resolve the Arahbo trigger, creating a 1/1 Cat creature token.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Cat token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

728-1765-6888.description:
Cast Traveling Plague by paying {3}{B}{B}, attaching it to another creature you control.
When Traveling Plague enters, Chishiro triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature Traveling Plague is attached to.
When the creature dies, Traveling Plague triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the token created in step 2.
When Traveling Plague enters, Chishiro triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat from step 3.

3175-7424-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Changing Loyalty triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Changing Loyalty from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

206-1368-6006-6321.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
206-1368-6006-6321.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

372-4477-7174.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Personify exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-4477-7174.description:
Cast Personify by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Greenwarden of Murasa and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Greenwarden of Murasa trigger.
Resolve the Greenwarden of Murasa trigger, returning Personify from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Personify.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Greenwarden of Murasa and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

1292-3117-3836-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and putting Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Jace's Erasure triggers, causing you to mill Sensei's Divining Top.
When Sensei's Divining Top is milled, Grolnok triggers, exiling Sensei's Divining Top with a croak counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from exile by paying {0}.
Repeat.

requires.n: Land with Cycling Cost that can be paid using one colored mana

65-615-2546-2628--38.description:
Activate the land's cycling ability by paying {0} due to Fluctuator and discarding it.
When you cycle the land, Escape Protocol and Surly Badgersaur trigger.
Resolve Surly Badgersaur's ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding (1).
Resolve Escape Protocol's ability, paying {1} to blink Cartographer.
When Cartographer enters, it triggers, returning the cycled land from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the activated ability from step 1, drawing a card.
65-615-2546-2628--38.notes: Since you can draw your entire library, discarding down to maximum hand size at end of turn will trigger Surly Badgersaur's abilities many times.

3234-3293-5414-6797.easyPrerequisites: You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
3234-3293-5414-6797.description:
Activate Troubled Healer by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 1 until you control no lands.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing World Shaper.
When World Shaper dies, it triggers, return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning World Shaper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all remaining Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat
3234-3293-5414-6797.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

518-5026-6191.notablePrerequisites:
Bloodthirsty Conqueror has indestructible.
You control another indestructible creature.
You have a way to deal damage to Bloodthirsty Conqueror.
518-5026-6191.description:
Cast Arcbond by paying {2}{R}, targeting Bloodthirsty Conqueror.
Holding priority, cast Reverberate by paying its mana cost, copying Arcbond, with the copy targeting another indestructible creature you control.
Resolve both Arcbonds.
Deal damage to Bloodthirsty Conqueror.
Arbond triggers, dealing that much damage to each player and each other creature.
Bloodthirsty Conqueror triggers for each opponent dealt damage, and Arcbond triggers due to the other indestructible creature being dealt damage.
Resolve all Bloodthirsty Conqueror triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve the Arcbond trigger, dealing that much damage to each player and each other creature.
Bloodthirsty Conqueror triggers for each opponent dealt damage, and Arcbond triggers due to Bloodthirsty Conqueror being dealt damage.
Resolve all Bloodthirsty Conqueror triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve the Arcbond trigger, dealing that much damage to each player and each other creature.
Repeat form step 6.

1812-4222-5149-5516.easyPrerequisites:
Freed from the Real attached to Red Death.
Power Artifact attached to Prismite.
1812-4222-5149-5516.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent controls a creature.
Red Death does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Red Death.
1812-4222-5149-5516.description:
Activate Red Death by tapping it, adding {R}, goading a creature an opponent controls and causing that opponent to draw a card.
Activate Prismite by paying {1}, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Red Death.
Repeat.

2438-3951-4875-5703.notablePrerequisites:
Altaïr does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr.
You have at least one legendary creature card exiled with a memory counter on it.
Conspiracy on the battlefield with "Assassin" chosen.
2438-3951-4875-5703.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker. Altaïr triggers, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it, and then creating a tapped and attacking token copy of each card you own that is exiled with a memory counter on it.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing another legendary creature token except Éomer.
When the creature dies, Éomer triggers, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat during each combat phase.

277-880-2783.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
277-880-2783.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control.
If the creature was a Dragon Egg, it triggers, creating a 2/2 Dragon creature token.
Resolve the Perilous Forays ability, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, Nesting Dragon and Tiller Engine trigger.
Resolve the Nesting Dragon trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Tiller Engine trigger, untapping the land.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

3542-4067-5922.notablePrerequisites:
Helga does not have summoning sickness and has power 4 or greater.
You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}{U}, plus an amount of generic mana equal to {7} minus Helga's power.
3542-4067-5922.description:
Activate Helga by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}{U} that can only be spent to cast creature spells with mana value 4 or greater or creature spells with {X} in their mana cost.
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}{U}, plus up to an additional {3} if needed.
Cast Palinchron by paying {5}{U}{U}.
Helga triggers, causing you to draw a card, gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Helga.
When Palinchron enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate Palinchron by paying {2}{U}{U}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Helga.
Repeat.
3542-4067-5922.notes: If you have enough leftover mana to cast Palinchron, you can instead substitute untapping another permanent instead of Helga.

1525-2031-2406-2660-5399.notablePrerequisites:
Pirated Copy is a copy of Stormchaser Drake.
Wheel of Sun and Moon attached to you.
1525-2031-2406-2660-5399.description:
Cast Lightning Storm by paying {1}{R}{R}, targeting either copy of Stormchaser Drake.
Stormchaser Drake triggers, which due to Abundance causes you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a land card and put it into your hand.
Activate Lightning Storm by discarding a land card, putting that land card on the bottom of your library due to Wheel of Sun and Moon.
Resolve the Lightning Storm ability, putting two charge counters on it and changing the target to the other copy of Stormchaser Drake.
Repeat from step 2.
Once Lightning Storm has an arbitrarily large number of charge counters, activate it by discarding a land to change its target to any other target of your choosing to deal infinite damage to that target.
1525-2031-2406-2660-5399.notes: Other players may also activate Lightning Storm to change its target, making this combo risky if you do not have additional land cards in hand to activate Lightning Storm again.

2084-3633.notablePrerequisites: "Spirit" chosen with Mirror of the Forebears.
2084-3633.description:
Activate Mirror of the Forebears by paying {1}, causing it to become a copy of Mirror-Mad Phantasm until end of turn.
Activate Mirror of the Forebears by paying {1}{U}, shuffling Mirror of the Forebears into your library and milling your entire library due to it not having a card named Mirror-Mad Phantasm in it.

3525-3784-4055.notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Vhal.
Vhal does not have summoning sickness.
3525-3784-4055.description:
Activate Vhal by tapping it, adding at least {C}{C}{C} that cannot be spent to cast spells from your hand.
Activate Energy Refractor by paying {2}, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Vhal.
Repeat.

2034-2059-4599.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four other Zombies.
2034-2059-4599.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Village Bell-Ringer, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Gravespawn Sovereign by tapping five untapped Zombies you control, returning Village Bell-Ringer from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Village Bell-Ringer enters the battlefield, untapping all creatures you control.
Repeat.

618-2645-4262-5313.notablePrerequisites: You control at least eight additional creatures.
618-2645-4262-5313.description:
Tap Kiki-Jiki to create a token copy of Angel of Renewal with haste.
The token enters gaining you at least 12 life.
Pay 12 life to Treasonous Ogre to add {R}{R}{R}{R}.
Pay {1} to untap Staff of Domination and {3} and tap Staff of Domination to untap Kiki-Jiki.
Repeat.

617-2179-3941.description:
Activate Coveted Jewel by tapping it, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Activate Voltaic Key by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting itself.
Kurkesh triggers, causing you to pay {R} to copy Voltaic Key's ability, targeting Coveted Jewel.
Resolve both Voltaic Key abilities, untapping it and Coveted Jewel.
Repeat.
